svg.title: Empire (transversal) interlock network

g.text: Forges et aciéries du Nord et de l'Est

svg.text: 13 firms in 6 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 365 firms, 1,355 interlocks, 7 components (largest 352). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 98 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
